5. Fixation of Pay on Promotion on or after 1-1-2016 from one Level
2. to another.-
3. (i) One increment shall be given in the level from which the employee is promoted and he shall be placed at a cell equal to the figure so arrived at in the level of the post to which promoted and if no such cell is available in the level to which promoted, he shall be placed at the next higher cell in that level.
